categories.AVAILABLE_SOURCE_IMAGERY: Controls 1 and 2 (9 Li GeoTIFF slices + Level-1 GRD measurement TIFFs on AWS S3 COG)
categories.MISSING_SOURCE_IMAGERY: Controls 3-12 (38 Li GeoTIFF slices absent locally, only PNG masks available)
categories.AVAILABLE_METADATA_ONLY: Controls 3-12 (Level-1 XML annotation and manifest.safe present in scratch/s1_annotations/)

radiometric_audit.conversion_rationale: Li GeoTIFFs contain uncalibrated scaled integer amplitude/power rasters. Converting to physical sigma-naught in dB is unsupported because calibration factors were not documented by Li authors. Normalized cross-correlation (NCC) is invariant to linear positive scaling and evaluates intensity structure directly.

candidate_search_space.crop_placement: Native Level-1 bounding box with grid origin 50 cells and 2560 cell stride
candidate_search_space.scale: 10x reduction (2560x2560 native cells to 256x256 Li pixels)

discovery_confirmation_evaluation.generalization_note: Preferred transformation selected on Control 1 (identity orientation, 10x block mean, zero shift) generalized to Control 2 without any re-tuning, achieving median NCC = 0.9387 across all 5 confirmation slices.

calibrated_threshold_recommendation.empirical_basis: Empirical negative controls never exceed NCC = 0.40 (max 0.399 at +500 lines, median 0.051). True aligned positive pairs achieve masked NCC >= 0.853 (median 0.940). A threshold of 0.70 provides a +0.30 margin above any negative control, and 0.85 separates high-quality interior crops.

alignment_classification_rationale: Empirical SAR intensity correspondence is firmly established for Controls 1 and 2 (9 slices, median NCC 0.940, peak displacement 0.0). However, 38 slices across Controls 3-12 lack physical Li GeoTIFF imagery and remain unverified. Generalizing orientation from Controls 1-2 to Controls 3-12 is scientifically prohibited.
dataset_construction_conditions: Condition 1: Full-scene Level-1 source ingestion must use verified orientation (identity) and 10x block averaging.
Condition 2: Only scenes with verified Level-1 SAFE source imagery can be included in OPS-01 training/dev.
Condition 3: For slices originating from Controls 3-12, direct empirical correlation must be performed whenever source GeoTIFFs become available; orientation cannot be blindly inherited.
Condition 4: Zero GPU compute, zero model training, and zero benchmark contamination remain strictly enforced.

incidents.title: Swath Edge / Scene Border Zero-Masking Artifact in Li Slices
incidents.description: Slice 7 of Control 1 contained 5,579 exact zero pixels (8.5% of raster) where Li authors zero-padded the edge of swath. This depressed raw NCC to 0.4349. Restricting evaluation to non-zero pixels restored NCC to 0.8536.
incidents.root_cause: Li dataset authors zeroed out invalid/nodata border pixels without adding a nodata tag in the GeoTIFF header.
incidents.guardrail_blindspot: Assuming Li GeoTIFFs contain only valid SAR backscatter and no zero-padding.
incidents.correction: Compute both raw NCC and valid-pixel (masked) NCC, reporting zero fractions explicitly.
incidents.lesson_learned: Never evaluate correlation without inspecting zero/nodata masks on scene margins.

incidents.title: Absence of Physical Li GeoTIFF Rasters for Controls 3-12
incidents.description: While 47 slice label masks exist for the 12 control scenes, only 9 Li GeoTIFF slices (Controls 1 and 2) exist in scratch/li_sample/Image_Geo/. Controls 3-12 have only PNG masks, preventing physical SAR intensity correlation for 38 slices.
incidents.root_cause: Historical pilot extraction in Phase 7C extracted sample imagery for Controls 1 and 2 only.
incidents.guardrail_blindspot: Earlier phases conflating label mask existence with source imagery existence.
incidents.correction: Explicitly categorize Controls 3-12 as MISSING_SOURCE_IMAGERY and INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
incidents.lesson_learned: Label masks are not SAR imagery; correspondence requires empirical backscatter from both source and target.
